**Triage: lands in the OAuth bootstrap path (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth`); `domain:services`; `priority:p2`.**

The `sys_oauth_resource` bootstrap row is **re-inserted on every boot** and its **UNIQUE refusal is now logged at ERROR** ⇒ **an idempotent step reporting as a failure**, on every boot after the first.

⇒ p2, same reasoning as its sibling: an ERROR on the happy path is a lie about the system's health, and it costs the operator's attention permanently rather than once.

⇒ ⭐ **Prefer making the step genuinely idempotent** (check-then-insert, or an upsert) **over silencing the log.** The current shape *depends on a constraint violation as control flow* — that is why the ERROR appeared the moment the log level changed, and silencing it would leave the same fragile mechanism one refactor away from doing it again.

⚠️ If an upsert is not available on every supported driver, say so and fall back to a handled check — ⛔ but state which drivers you verified.

⚠️ **Sibling from the same boot, ⛔ not a fold (different package, different lane):** objectstack#17175 (`_objectstack_sequences` probe at ERROR). ⇒ **serial only in the sense that whoever goes second should re-count the ERRORs on a clean boot and report the remaining number.**

⭐ Filed at the destination per hotclm's `AGENTS.md` — *report, never patch*.

`Size/model suggestion:` M.

## The limb that no longer holds

The title says 「its UNIQUE refusal **is now logged at ERROR**」. It is not, and it has not been since `0780e8848` — *fix(objectql): report a refused write at `warn`, not `error` — the caller was already told (#17211)*, closing #17052.

All three write doors in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` now log at **`warn`**:

| door | line | call |
|:--|--:|:--|
| insert | `:11069` | `this.logger.warn('Insert operation failed', writeFailureLogMeta(…))` |
| update | `:12624` | `this.logger.warn('Update operation failed', …)` |
| delete | `:14081` | `this.logger.warn('Delete operation failed', …)` |

⭐ **Control, so the `warn`-only reading is not a dead grep:** `logger.error` is still present in the same file — e.g. `:7725` `this.logger.error('Failed to connect driver', …)`. The probe finds `error` where `error` exists; it finds `warn` at these three doors because that is what is there.

⭐ **And #17052's own docblock names THIS card's exact scenario as the cost it was paid to remove** — `engine.ts:481`–`:495`, verbatim:

> The measured cost was a healthy first boot of every fresh project printing `ERROR Insert operation failed` while `@better-auth/oauth-provider` seeded `sys_oauth_resource` and treated the UNIQUE collision as the no-op its own docblock declares it to be.

⇒ Same object, same seeding path, same collision. That half of this card was fixed by another lane, on its own reading, before this card could be dispatched.

## What survives, stated narrowly

The **first** limb — 「the bootstrap row is re-inserted on every boot」 — this seat did **not** measure and does not claim either way. If it holds it is still a real defect and still lands in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, so still this lane. But its harm is now materially smaller than the card describes: a `warn` on an expected, idempotent first-boot collision is noise, ⛔ not 「an idempotent step **reporting as a failure**」. The failure-report framing is gone.

⇒ **Whoever takes this next re-cuts it to the surviving question first:** *does the seeding path re-insert unconditionally on every boot, and should it not?* ⛔ Do not dispatch it on the title as written — the `ERROR` half will not reproduce, and a dev sent to fix it will correctly report a null.

## Deferred this pass, and the pit for the taker

Not dispatched now: the maintainer's standing water line for this lane is 3 in-flight devs and all three seats are occupied (#15972, #16390, #17322).

⚠️ **Known pit, recorded now rather than rediscovered.** The seeding surface measured today is `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` (`:2427`, `:3506`–`:3513`, `:6083`) and `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts:673`. **PR #17454** (issue #17440, another seat — the better-auth account-issuer rollback) is open and **holds `auth-schema-config.ts`** (+11/−13) along with `plugin-auth`'s `package.json`, `src/index.ts`, `src/auth-plugin.ts`, `src/objectql-adapter.ts` and `tsup.config.ts`. ⇒ `auth-manager.ts` itself is free, but `auth-schema-config.ts` is **not**: if the re-cut fix reaches it, this card is hard-serial behind #17454 and must wait for it to merge. Re-read that PR's state at claim time.

## ⚠️ Dispatched RE-CUT, ⛔ not on the title as written

Both limbs of the title are in doubt and the dev is told so as the first thing they must falsify:

- **Limb 2 — 「its UNIQUE refusal is now logged at ERROR」 — FALSIFIED**, by this seat at 2026-09-10T16:06Z and unchanged since: all three write doors in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` log at `warn` after `0780e8848` (#17211, closing #17052), with `logger.error` still present elsewhere in the same file as the firing control. ⇒ The "reporting as a failure" framing is gone.
- **Limb 1 — 「re-inserted on every boot」 — CONTESTED.** The `repo:hotcrm` seat measured four consecutive boots on sqlite: **first boot 1, boots 2–4 zero**, each zero paired with a `Server is ready` control in the same log. ⛔ That is one driver and one app, so it does not falsify a per-boot claim on Postgres or under concurrency — but it does mean the card's own premise is unmeasured on the tree.

## The surviving question, and where this seat measured it lands

*Does our side hand `@better-auth/oauth-provider` a seed that will collide on every init, and is there anything we can do about it that is ours to do?*

Measured on `origin/main` @ `76ddab772`, 2026-09-10T17:59Z: the seeding is the **vendor plugin's**, driven from options we pass at `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts:3479`–`:3513` — `oauthProvider({ … resources … })`, whose own comment there says 「`resources` seeds the sys_oauth_resource row from the plugin's …」. The registration itself arrived in `142c01c88` (#16780). And `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:494` records that #17052 **already priced this exact collision**, naming this object and this seeding path, and deliberately chose `warn` over silencing it.

⇒ A measured 「this is the vendor's insert-and-ignore, and #17052 already ruled on its noise」 is a **good outcome** for this card, not a failure to fix it. ⛔ The dev is told not to manufacture a fix to justify the dispatch.

## Declared file surface, and the fence

**Free, and the only intended write surface:** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` plus a NEW test file of the dev's own naming.

⛔ **Hard-fenced — PR #17454 (issue #17440, another seat, open draft, 37 files) holds every one of these:** `auth-schema-config.ts`, `auth-plugin.ts`, `index.ts`, `objectql-adapter.ts`, `admin-user-endpoints.ts`, `package.json`, **`auth-manager.test.ts`**, and `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts`. If the answer needs any of them, the dev **stops and reports** — this card is then hard-serial behind #17454 and waits. ⛔ `packages/spec` is this lane's red line regardless of who needs it.

⚠️ Note the fence includes `auth-manager.test.ts`: the pins go in a new file, ⛔ not into the held one.

## Verify-lock arrival depth

`scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh --status` read immediately before dispatch: `state: lock is free`, `queue: empty` ⇒ arrival depth = 0 `queue N:` lines + 1 = **1**, under `LOCK_DEPTH_HOLD` = 2.
